observations: Photo 0: Front view of a stainless steel standing gas cooker with four burners (two on top, two on bottom), five white control knobs, and an oven door open to show a wire rack. The top surface shows signs of use and some discoloration.
Photo 1: Side view showing the top burners and control knobs. The top surface has visible stains and residue, especially on the left burner. The oven door is open, revealing the interior.

Photo 2: Rear view showing the back of the cooker with a control panel and a small label or sticker near the bottom left. The back has some rust and wear. The oven door is open, showing the interior rack.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HITHE TECHNOLOGIES'.
The cooker appears to be a 4-burner gas hob with an oven, typical of a standing gas cooker.

claims.claim: Neat refurbished standing Gas Cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear, stains, and rust on the top surface and back. No proof of functionality (e.g., lit burners, oven heating). The term 'perfect working condition' cannot be verified from still images.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite or may be damaged.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing all burners lit and functioning.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or may be damaged.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the oven door closed and the interior light on, with the oven heating up.

risks.risk: Control knobs may be faulty or not adjust properly.
risks.proof: Video showing each knob turning and controlling the flame.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or rust on the back or sides not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the entire back and sides of the cooker, including the control panel and any rusted areas.

proof_requests: Video showing all burners lit and functioning.
Video showing the oven door closed and the interior light on, with the oven heating up.
Video showing each control knob turning and controlling the flame.
Photo or video showing the entire back and sides of the cooker, including the control panel and any rusted areas.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
